shared_elements: low-relief carved symbolic designs on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief symbolic carvings including circular/disc motifs and curving bands, and both involve human-related imagery, but that is the extent of the correspondence. A is a three-dimensional monolithic figure whose back carries a few large isolated curvilinear motifs, while B is a flat register-divided panel with a winged disc, a row of standing figures facing each other, and multiple ruled lines of dense script signs — an organised pictorial-and-textual scheme absent from A.
